definitions.explanation: The practice of restraining oneself from indulging in desires, especially physical or material pleasures. Can refer to religious asceticism or general self-discipline.

examples.japanese: {禁欲的|きんよくてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禁欲|きんよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: To continue abstinence as part of religious training.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{禁欲的|きんよくてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{無駄遣|むだづか}い→無駄遣い：07310_mudazukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has an ascetic personality and never wastes money.

notes:
Describes the restraint of desires and self-denial. Can range from religious asceticism (monks, spiritual practice) to more general self-discipline (avoiding excess spending, controlling appetites).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁欲的|きんよくてき}: ascetic, austere (na-adjective)
- {禁欲的|きんよくてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: ascetic lifestyle
- {禁欲|きんよく}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: asceticism (as a philosophy)
- {禁欲|きんよく}⟦{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}→〜主義者：28362_shugisha⟧: ascetic (person)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese religious traditions, {禁欲|きんよく} is associated with Buddhist monks and Shinto ascetics ({修験者|しゅげんじゃ}) who practice extreme self-denial. In modern usage, it can also describe someone with a stoic, self-disciplined personality.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{節制|せっせい}→節制：16729_sessei⟧: moderation, temperance — less extreme; about moderating excess rather than complete denial
- {断食|だんじき}: fasting — specifically refers to abstaining from food
- {克己|こっき}: self-mastery — emphasizes conquering one's own weaknesses

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{禁|きん}→禁：28295_kin⟧ (prohibit, abstain) + ⟦{欲|よく}→欲：13183_yoku⟧ (desire, craving).
